title: AI Motion Studio project (schemaVersion 2)
description: Units: meters, degrees, seconds. Character faces +Z when yaw=0. Each track animates ONE channel. Key = [time, value, ease?]; ease belongs to the segment ENDING at this key (smooth = smoothstep, linear, hold = jump at key). Before the first key the first value holds; after the last key the last value holds. A channel without a track stays at rest (joint rotation 0, root = character position/yaw). Joint sign convention: shoulder/hip forward = negative X, elbow flex = negative X, knee flex = positive X, finger curl = positive X. Files without schemaVersion are schema 1 (v0.11 and older) and load unchanged.

schemaVersion.description: Data-structure version. Not the app version.

app.description: App version that saved the file (informational), e.g. "0.12".

legacyVersion.description: Old free-form "version" label kept from schema-1 files.

duration.description: Seconds; all key times should be ≤ duration.

position.description: Rest root position [x, y, z] in meters; y=0 is the floor.

objects.description: Boxes. Animate with actor "@object:<index>", joint "$root", axis px|py|pz (m), rx|ry|rz (deg), sx|sy|sz (size m).

axis.description: x/y/z = absolute world position (m); yaw = absolute heading (deg).

oneOf.title: Hand preset
oneOf.description: Drives all 15 finger joints of one hand; poses blend between keys. An explicit finger track of the same hand overrides the preset for that joint/axis.

cameraKeys.description: [time, azimuth°, elevation°, distance m, ease?, targetX?, targetY?, targetZ?]. Target defaults to [0, 1, 0].

numberKeys.description: Sorted by time, no duplicate times.

joint.description: Hierarchy: hips > spine > chest > neck > head; chest > {L,R}_clavicle > _shoulder > _elbow > _forearm > _wrist > _finger{0-4}_{0-2} (0 = thumb); hips > {L,R}_hip > _knee > _ankle > _toe{0-4}_{0-1}.
